Desc.DescText: It is a legislative requirement that children (under 12), are seated where they can be supervised by an accompanying adult.
Children (under 12) are required to be seated next to at least one adult that they're travelling with. “Next to” can be Across the Aisle, In front of, Behind, Adjacent to

MarketingInfo.DescText: To sit in our Exit Row Seats, there are a few things we need to make you aware of
The passenger must be at least 16 years old on the day of travel, and they cannot be travelling with infants.
They must also be fit and able bodied as in an emergency situation they will need to be able to open the exit door unaided.
